title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock II
statement_short: Given an integer array prices, find the maximum total profit achieved by completing as many stock transactions as you like. You may only hold at most one share of the stock at any time.
hint: Limit of 3 \* 10^4 demands an O(n) single pass, accumulating positive price differences between consecutive days.
keywords: as many stock transactions as you like
why_not: Right: Greedy sums every positive daily price increase (prices[i] - prices[i-1]) to capture all profitable upward slopes in O(n) time. Not Backtracking: Exploring all transaction decision combinations results in O(2^n) exponential time. Not Intervals: Merging transaction intervals adds unnecessary complexity when daily differences suffice. Not Binary Search: Price values are not sorted, so binary search cannot determine transaction points.
